info.title: ActualPay API
info.description: ActualPay HTTP API. Authenticate integrations with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer apk_...`); the dashboard uses a session cookie plus an `X-CSRF-Token` header. Amounts are decimal strings; never floats. See docs/api.md.
